transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I just… I don’t see things getting back on track anymore. My studio, my life, all of it. No matter how hard I work or whatever payment plan gets put in front of me, it feels like it’s not going to be enough.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time lately?

Yeah. Most days I wake up and it’s already there, this heavy, gray feeling. It doesn’t really lift. Even when I’m in the shop, around the wood and tools—stuff I used to really care about—it just feels flat. Sometimes I catch myself just standing there, staring, and I have to force myself to move.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?
I don’t know. I mean… I don’t really have a clear answer for that. Things just don’t feel the way they used to, but I can’t say exactly what still feels enjoyable.
Are there any activities that you still look forward to or enjoy doing?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of anything I actually look forward to right now. Some things are familiar, like being in the shop, but I wouldn’t say I enjoy them exactly.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to care about?
I think so, yeah. I can’t really point to one thing and say exactly when it changed, but the stuff I used to care about just doesn’t pull me in anymore. It’s more like I go through the motions.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?
I haven’t really noticed, honestly. I don’t weigh myself much, so I can’t say for sure if it’s changed.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than usual or having trouble sitting still?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed myself moving slower or being unable to sit still. I guess I just do what I have to do, but I don’t know if it looks different from usual.
Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to live or wishing you were dead?
I… I don’t really know how to answer that. I haven’t thought about it clearly enough to say.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to die?
I’m still not sure. I don’t think I can say yes to that, but I also don’t feel like I’ve sorted it out in my head enough to give you a clear answer.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself?
I’m not sure. I haven’t had a clear thought like, “I’m going to hurt myself,” but… I don’t know, it’s hard to say more than that.
Have you been thinking that you would be better off dead?
I’m not sure. I can’t say I’ve been thinking that exactly… it’s more like I don’t have a clear answer to it.
Have you been thinking about ending your life?
I don’t know. I haven’t really been able to say that I’m thinking about ending my life… it’s more like I feel unsure when you ask it that directly.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been going on since I took on the studio mortgage… a little over two years ago. About two years and two months now.
Do you feel like you have been moving slower than you usually do?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself moving slower, exactly. Maybe I feel slowed down inside sometimes, but I don’t know if other people would see it.
Do you feel like you've been restless or having trouble staying still?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed being restless or needing to move around a lot. I can sit still, I think… it’s more just hard to tell sometimes.
Do you feel like you've been fidgeting or having trouble staying still lately?
I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t noticed myself fidgeting much or feeling like I can’t sit still. It’s not something that really stands out to me.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really been tracking my weight, and I haven’t noticed a big drop or anything like that.
Do you feel like you're moving slower physically than you used to?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself moving slower physically, at least not in a way that stands out to me.
Have you noticed any significant change in your clothing size over the past few months?
No, I haven’t really noticed my clothes fitting much differently. Same size as far as I can tell.
Do you feel like you have been moving slower than you usually do physically?
I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t noticed that I’m physically moving slower than usual.
